title: Rune Slate

sources.title: Rune Slate
markers: '''Rune Slates''' are [[Books|Book]]-like items found on the [[Nautiloid]] and in the [[Mind Flayer Colony]]. When "read", the Narrator describes the mental images they impart.

sources.role: Rules: Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite
sources.title: Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite

summary: Reading the Nautiloid schematic grants an Omeluum dialogue advantage.

fields.Dialogue: Read the prologue schematic slate. Later, when trading knowledge with Omeluum, it unlocks the schematic-detail option with Advantage on DC 10 Intelligence.
fields.Colony slates: Different examples request DC 14 Arcana. The pinned source reports their text still displays on failure, with a different reader comment.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
